ai_summary: Ambika Cotton Mills Limited reported robust financial performance for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026, with revenue from operations increasing by approximately 38% and 33.5% year-over-year, respectively, and Profit Before Tax surging by 68% and 63.5% over the same periods. This indicates strong top-line growth and improved overall profitability. While these results are positive, a significant quarter-over-quarter increase of over 40% in the cost of materials consumed, disproportionate to the modest 2.7% revenue growth, warrants closer investigation into raw material pricing, production volumes, or inventory management strategies.
